description.translate: Bring twelve sheets of paper. I will copy the surviving observations and restore the reference shelves. Knowledge that exists in only one damaged notebook is knowledge waiting to disappear. Hand the materials to me one at a time.

The copied readings show the same sequence: the resonance rose, the couplings shook, then the frame gave way. We had a warning and a measurable cause. The Ranker wanted a stronger result before we had made the apparatus safe for it.
